text:
Marina: Tariq from Jacaranda sent over their security questionnaire and asked for a joint POC. They want SAML SSO, KMS/HSM integration, EU data residency, and a latency SLO <150ms tail. Can we triage?
Alex: I can run the POC SE side. Need a test tenant and their sample prompts. Also need an estimate for dedicated capacity pricing for a ~5k monthly request pilot.
Megan: Sales wants a very rough topline number to include in the LOI. Is 4x A10G a reasonable starting point? What delta vs hosted should we show?
Jordan: Heads up — if they insist on HSM-backed keys we likely need Private or a Dedicated + customer-managed KMS option. Priya can confirm controls.
Priya: On first read the questionnaire flags: customer-controlled key management, data residency, SOC2 evidence, and SCIM for user provisioning. For HSM we need to outline options: 1) Private with BYOK/HSM, 2) Dedicated where customer supplies KMS via network peering and we document access controls. Will need the PDF.
Marina: Pasted excerpt from Tariq: "Pilot: 8 weeks, 5k monthly requests, telemetry to partner Splunk, must support Azure AD SAML + SCIM, and formal KMS runbook."
Kevin: Latency SLO note — depends on model and region. For eu-west dedicated with optimized quantized model it's plausible. Quick local perf run below for a 6.7B quantized model:
Kevin: ```
# perf snippet
model: opt-6.7b-q8
seq: 512
p50: 48ms
p95: 138ms
```
Alex: Good signal. For pricing we can propose: hosted pilot (usage-based) vs discounted Dedicated commit (monthly). I'll draft two options: pay-as-you-go hosted + entitlements, or 3-month reserved with X% pilot discount.
Megan: Include entitlements checklist: telemetry export (s3/http), 90d traces, per-route dashboards, and telemetry schema for Splunk. Also note integration work for SCIM provisioning.
Priya: Security items to close: KMS access runbook, key rotation policy, encryption-in-transit certs, SOC2 docs (we can share the audit pack), and a short comms on incident reporting. I'll start a redlined response to their questionnaire.
Jordan: Procurement blocker: their legal has a "no SaaS for PII" clause. Marina, did Tariq indicate willingness to run Private later?
Marina: He said they'd prefer hosted for speed but may accept Private for production. For the pilot they're open to hosted or Dedicated as long as KMS controls are documented.
Marina: Action items: 
- Alex + Kevin: provision test tenant, run perf with partner prompts (I'll DM prompts).
- Megan: draft pilot quote (hosted vs dedicated) + entitlements, include Splunk export details.
- Priya: review questionnaire and produce KMS/HSM runbook draft.
- Jordan: prepare one-slide architecture (hosted vs dedicated vs private) focused on data flow and key ownership.
- Marina: schedule Wed 10am PT sync with Tariq (I'll send invite).
Alex: Ack — I'll spin up tenant and post results here by EOD.
Megan: I'll have the draft quote by EOD tomorrow.
Priya: I'll get first pass on the questionnaire by tomorrow noon.
Kevin: I'll run perf matrix across seq lengths and post numbers.
Marina: Thanks team :thumbsup: If we can close the KMS question this week we should be able to move to LOI stage.
